question:
Choose an appropriate synonym for the given word.

Cease
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cease"** means to stop or come to an end. (रोकना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company decided to** cease **operations due to financial losses.
 
 
 
• **"Conclude"** means to bring something to an end or to finish. (समाप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting will **conclude **at 5 PM.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the **synonym** of **'Cease'** is **'Conclude'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Continue** (जारी रखना): To keep going or persist in an activity.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the rain, the match** continued.**
 
 
 
• **Transmit** (प्रेषित करना): To send or convey from one person or place to another.
 
 
• **Example:** The radio station** transmits **signals across the country.
 
 
 
• **Commence** (आरंभ करना): To begin or start.
 
 
• **Example:** The ceremony will **commence** at 10 AM.
